rules: Jem'Hadar have strongly non-Human craniofacial morphology with pronounced ridges/projections and textured/mottled dermal presentation.
Cranial ridge/projection topology varies by individual and belongs to persistent identity.
Accelerated maturation affects lifecycle/age-state, not permission to regenerate a different face.
Ketracel-white delivery hardware, weapons and armor are equipment/state layers and require actual Dominion service/resource context.
forbidden_variation: automatic weapon/armor in civilian/medical portrait context
notes: Military socialization is not encoded as a permanently aggressive face.
